{{Quote|You should've bargained, Jabba. That's the last mistake you'll ever make!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
The '''Rescue of Han Solo''' was the campaign orchestrated by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to rescue his friend, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and free him from his [[Carbonite/Legends|Carbonite]] [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|imprisonment]]. The first phase of the campaign, the [[Mission to Jabba's Palace]], ended with the capture of Skywalker and most of his friends. They then improvised an escape in the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> A third incident took place in space as members of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's criminal empire]] attempted to run an imperial blockade of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a diversion which allowed the Rebels to escape the planet.<ref name="Prophecies and Destinies">{{RJRadio|Prophecies and Destinies}}</ref>

==The campaign==
Following the [[Battle over Coruscant]], Luke Skywalker, along with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] organized a plan to rescue Han Solo from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The plan entailed several phases of infiltration of the palace.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], knowing that Skywalker or other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] might attempt to stage such a rescue, positioned a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] in orbit around [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to capture any incoming Rebels. The group contained more than one [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in addition to other starships. The blockade made it impossible for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to consider freeing Solo with a direct attack; therefore Skywalker had to form a plan to enter the palace in secret.<ref name="Prophecies and Destinies" />

===Infiltration of Jabba's palace===
{{Quote|I am taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this or be destroyed. It's your choice, but I warn you not to underestimate my powers.|Luke Skywalker, to Jabba Desilijic Tiure|audio=IAmTakingCaptainSolo.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
{{Main|Siege of Jabba's Palace}}
[[File:Return_of_the_Jedi_TCG_by_David_Nash.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Return of the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Jedi]].]]
The first phase had Lando infiltrate [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], disguised as the guard [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Tamtel Skreej]], as a contingency should anything go wrong. The second phase involved sending [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to the palace to peacefully offer Jabba the opportunity to release Han, with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] themselves as a gift. When this failed, phase three involved Leia, posing as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], delivering a supposedly-captured Chewbacca to Jabba for a bounty. Leia would have then freed Han in the night, released Chewbacca and escaped with them and Lando. When Jabba saw through the attempted rescue and captured all three (excluding Lando, who remained in disguise), they were forced to move to the final phase. Luke Skywalker entered the palace and, by means of several [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]] made his way to Jabba's throne room. He underestimated Jabba however and, after killing [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's pet]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], wound up captured and sentenced to death, along with Han and Chewbacca.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

===Trip to the Pit of Carkoon===
{{Quote|Jabba, this is your last chance. Free us, or die.|Luke Skywalker at the Great Pit of Carkoon|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />}}
{{Main|Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon}}
[[File:EscorttothePitofCarkoonTrevas.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Luke, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] escorted by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].]]

After being condemned to death in the gullet of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], Luke, Han and Chewbacca were taken to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Pit of Carkoon]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. They were transported on a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|desert skiff]] while Jabba and his minions traveled on [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], Jabba's [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]]. Once there, Luke was able to free himself with the help of R2-D2, and after a pitched struggle that saw the destruction of Jabba and his criminal empire, as well as the supposed demise of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Luke, Leia, Han, Chewbacca, Lando, and the droids escaped unharmed.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /><ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

===Confrontation over Tatooine===
To cover the Rebels' escape, R2-D2 had earlier sliced into the data network in Jabba's palace to make it appear that [[Imperial Death warrant]]s had been issued for Jabba's key surviving lieutenants. When members of Jabba's criminal empire saw this after their boss's death, they attempted to flee the planet en masse. A considerable flotilla of ships took off ready to blast their way past the Imperial blockade. The Imperial battle group intercepted the escaping ships, and a firefight erupted. This was enough to distract the Imperials as the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcoln]]'' and Luke Skywalker's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]] left the atmosphere to make their way back to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]].<ref name="Prophecies and Destinies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rescue of Han Solo first appeared in the beginning of the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> Though popularly assumed that [[George Lucas]] thought up the opening, it was, in reality, the idea of writer and director [[Richard Marquand]] and [[Lawrence Kasdan]]. The fact was eventually revealed via transcripts of meetings from ''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="TMoROTJ">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The presence of the Imperial fleet, along with their battle against Jabba's fleeing minions, was added by [[Brian Daley]] for the [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]].<ref name="Prophecies and Destinies" />
